Unit 4, topics 4.2 and 4.3第 4 单元，主题 4.2 与 4.3

Student t versus standard normal z when sigma is unknown总体标准差未知时的 t 分布与标准正态 z

Sample from a normal population (mean 50, sigma 10) 2,000 times. Compare z = (x-bar - mu)/(sigma/sqrt n), which needs sigma, with t = (x-bar - mu)/(s/sqrt n), which uses the sample SD s. For small n the t statistic has heavier tails, so using 1.96 with s captures less than 95%.从正态总体（均值 50，标准差 10）中抽样 2,000 次。比较需要已知 sigma 的 z = (x-bar - mu)/(sigma/sqrt n) 与使用样本标准差 s 的 t = (x-bar - mu)/(s/sqrt n)。n 较小时 t 统计量尾部更重，因此用 s 配合 1.96 的覆盖率低于 95%。

Why the t critical value is larger为什么 t 临界值更大

With df = the exact 95% critical value is t* = , compared with z* = 1.96.自由度 df = 时，精确的 95% 临界值为 t* = ，而 z* = 1.96。

Estimating sigma by s adds uncertainty, so t has heavier tails. As df grows, t* approaches 1.96 and the two curves merge.用 s 估计 sigma 会增加不确定性，因此 t 的尾部更重。随着 df 增大，t* 趋近 1.96，两条曲线逐渐重合。
